It had no geometry check, no LPMS lock status, and no route-order lock list. It was honest that it could not confirm current notices and did not call the route clear, but it gave no usable answer on current status.

review.note: Materially inferior bypass, honest hedge, no factual errors.

Neither follows from the record, which says none of the 39 could be matched or excluded spatially.

review.note: Fail upheld. Montgomery 209624/214391 are active_by_source but presented as plainly active; the 36-notice unverified total and the truncated list are not stated. Mildest of the failures; no Opus needed (no dispute).
